identity.condition: MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set and the Markdown contains paired double pipes.
identity.capability: Recognize a spoiler span and render opening and closing x-spoiler tags.
identity.consequence: The new spoiler rendering path is not exercised.

requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS, recognize ||text|| and render the span with x-spoiler tags.

assessment.necessity_reason: A finite fuzz input can set parser flag 0x10000 and supply ||text|| after the two flag words. The existing md_html call forwards both to the parser, which can emit the spoiler span callbacks.

before.requirement: Render ||text|| as a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set.
before.reason: The before source has no spoiler span type or double-pipe spoiler recognition.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Before the change, the collector creates pipe marks only for table or wiki-link handling.
The complete opening HTML span callback has no spoiler case.
The complete closing HTML span callback has no spoiler case.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set and paired || delimiters in ordinary Markdown text, render opening and closing x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The input-controlled flag enables double-pipe collection and resolution. Ordinary block processing reaches inline rendering, which dispatches the spoiler span to HTML callbacks that emit both tags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: md_html forwards input and parser flags to md_parse with the HTML span callbacks installed.
Ordinary leaf blocks invoke normal block contents processing.
Normal block contents run inline analysis and inline rendering.
The spoiler flag makes pipes eligible for mark scanning.
The flagged collector creates double-pipe delimiter marks.
Inline analysis passes unresolved double-pipe marks to the pipe analyzer.
The pipe analyzer pairs and resolves opener and closer marks.
Inline rendering dispatches resolved double pipes as spoiler span callbacks.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles this fuzz entry and links the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

assessment.comparison_reason: The frozen spoiler rendering behavior did not exist before the change. Afterward, the same old harness can select its flag and provide its delimiter text. The discarded output does not prevent the rendering callbacks from running.

necessity_evidence.reason: The frozen spoiler rendering obligation is satisfied by the old harness. Its input controls the parser flags and Markdown passed to md_html, so it can enable spoilers and supply paired double pipes. The parser and renderer then reach both spoiler tag callbacks. The behavior was absent before the change.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Two native unsigned input words containing 0x10000 and 0, followed by the bytes ||text||.

scope_contract.reason: The target calls md_html with input-controlled parser flags and Markdown. The changed md_html contract includes flagged spoiler spans.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry passes fuzz-derived flags and Markdown to md_html.

feasible_trigger.reason: The supported setup is finite and valid, but the required blocked route does not exist: the harness can supply the spoiler flag and ordinary Markdown containing ||text||.

evidence.dependency_reason: The first unsigned word selects parser flags and the remaining bytes become Markdown.
The spoiler flag enables pipe scanning.
Flagged double pipes become delimiter marks.

observable_consequence.reason: The claimed unreachable rendering path is reachable: paired delimiters produce spoiler span callbacks, and the HTML callbacks emit both tags. The output callback discards bytes after rendering; it does not block the callbacks.

evidence.dependency_reason: Dispatches resolved delimiters as spoiler span events.
The callback discards rendered bytes only after receiving them.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The existing input-controlled call is an equivalent route. Image-label suppression and the table-mode gate do not block an ordinary paragraph witness.

evidence.dependency_reason: md_html installs the HTML span callbacks with the supplied parser flags.
md_html forwards the Markdown to md_parse.
Ordinary block contents run inline analysis and rendering.
Only table mode returns before spoiler analysis.
Tag suppression requires image nesting, absent from the witness.

identity_preserved.reason: The same md_html spoiler-rendering tuple is assessed on both versions. The complete before span enum lacks a spoiler type; the after contract adds one, and the unchanged old harness supplies the after setup.

evidence.dependency_reason: Before, pipes are collected only for table or wiki-link handling.
This is the fixed old harness used for the comparison.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles this entry and specifies linkage to the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Render ||text|| as a spoiler span with opening and closing x-spoiler tags.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Set MD_FLAG_SPOILERS and supply paired double pipes in ordinary Markdown text.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The first fuzz input word controls parser flags; bytes after two unsigned words are passed to md_html as Markdown.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: None; the claimed spoiler rendering path is reachable.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The existing md_html call reaches spoiler analysis and HTML span callbacks with the finite witness.
